title: ID0456010-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P7 170000671] Screen out of order
description:
Reported behavior/issue -
Screen out of order. Only backlight visible and no RFID light. Pictures in the attachments.
Tried to reboot, power cycle and re seat the displayport cable. Issue still present.
The circuit board most likely faulty.
Possible Solution: Sent MLFB's for replacement parts + at the same time replace sharp edge dispenser cable rope roll set.
